notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least three charge counters on it.
description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {U} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {1}{U}.
When Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.
